questions.question: Estimate 38 × 247 and then calculate it exactly using the column method. Explain how the estimate supports your answer.
questions.expected_answer: Estimate: 40 × 250 = 10 000. Exact: 247 × 8 = 1 976 and 247 × 30 = 7 410, total 9 386. The exact answer is a little under the estimate, which makes sense because both numbers were rounded up.

questions.question: Calculate 9 386 ÷ 13 by long division and check your answer with an inverse operation.
What is compensating? Use it to calculate 247 + 198, and explain the role of a calculator in Grade 7.
questions.expected_answer: Compensating means changing a number to make the calculation easy, then adjusting the answer: 247 + 200 = 447, then subtract 2 to get 445. A calculator is used only to check answers already worked out, not to replace the method.
